partes.p: Estimate to the nearest .1 the value at the point $P$ of the directional derivative $\left(\dfrac{dh}{ds}\right)_{\hat{u}}$, where $\hat{u}$ is the unit vector in the direction of $\hat{\imath} + \hat{\jmath}$.
Show that the problem leads one to maximize $f(x, y) = xy - x^{3}y - xy^{3}$, and write down the equations for the critical points of $f$.

Suppose that $x^{2}y + xz^{2} = 5$, and let $w = x^{3}y$. Express $\left(\dfrac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)_{y}$ as a function of $x, y, z$, and evaluate it numerically when $(x, y, z) = (1, 1, 2)$.
